title: feat: add native POST /alpha/decisions endpoint for Jev
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Adds a native Jev endpoint so callers can submit typed decisions directly instead of encoding JSON inside a chat message. Follow-up to #15111.

- Adds `POST /alpha/decisions` with `{state, questions}`, defaulting to `jev`, and returns native `answers` plus token usage. Uses the OpenRouter decisions request contract; provider cost is omitted from the public response.
- Shares request/response schemas between Gen and Ask Jev MCP; removes the duplicate MCP question schema and switches the tool to the native endpoint.
- Uses the existing durable executor, cache, authorization, and billing. Keeps `/v1/chat/completions` compatibility and rejects Jev on `/text`.
- Preserves JSON HTTP 402 for exhausted balances/budgets; chat/text balance notices remain unchanged. Reuses `throwTextError` to preserve upstream failure statuses.
- Verifies 53 focused Gen tests, including both balance errors, missing provider usage, chat compatibility, and existing balance notices; all 9 MCP tests; Gen typecheck; MCP bundle dry run; Biome. MCP tests now exercise the native contract and authentication forwarding.

gist.headline: Decisions, Minus the JSON Origami
gist.blurb: Jev now has a native decisions endpoint for typed questions and answers. The hive can stop folding a structured request into a chat message just to unfold it again.
gist.summary: Added POST /alpha/decisions for Jev, accepting typed {state, questions} requests and returning native answers with token usage while reusing the existing executor, cache, authorization, and billing flow.
gist.impact: Developers can call Jev through a purpose-built decisions contract instead of embedding JSON in chat messages, while Ask Jev MCP now forwards the same native authenticated request and existing chat compatibility remains available.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy garden-workbench where Polli helps a retro terminal turn a messy folded chat scroll full of JSON braces into neat labeled decision cards: state, questions, answers. A small CRT monitor robot can proudly sort the cards beside a blooming code-plant, representing the shared Gen and Ask Jev MCP schema and the new direct endpoint.
